trello.name: Document the attack ticket incident
trello.desc: Hassan will document the attack ticket attempt including the raw ticket content, the summarizer's partial processing results, timestamps, and file it in the security log with a severity assessment. Deadline is within this week.

trello.name: Harden the ticket summarization pipeline
trello.desc: Wren will add a sanitization layer in the ticket parser to delimit quoted customer content and strip or neutralize instruction-like content before passing to the summarizer. This includes adding delimiters, an instruction-pattern filter, creating a regression test using this exact ticket as a test fixture, and adding an evaluation suite that runs injection attempts against the summarizer on every deploy. This task is approved and includes all related activities.

trello.name: Check the validity and reset email functionality of user jdoe443
trello.desc: Wren will verify whether the account 'jdoe443' is real by checking the password reset email delivery logs for the last week and investigate the complaint about password reset emails not arriving. If the account is a burner, it will be closed; if resets are broken, this will become its own incident.

trello.name: Provide list of new service accounts since May
trello.desc: Hassan will provide Grace with the list of service accounts created since May as part of the quarterly access review process. Deadline is Thursday.
